title: Application Engineer Architect (STA SignOff)
description:
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.
Key Responsibilities

•
Technical Expertise : Lead technical engagements with customers and partners to drive & adoption of Cadence signoff portfolio. Work closely with design teams to meet customer success metrics, guide adoption of Cadence’s timing signoff & closure and AgenticAI features across advanced nodes (5nm and below).

•
Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with R&D and Product Engineering to influence tool enhancements based on real-world customer requirements.

•
Innovation & Enablement : Drive complex benchmarks, flow optimizations, and deployment of cutting-edge methodologies for timing sigoff & closure, STA, IR Drop, and power/timing closure.

•
Thought Leadership : Represent Cadence at industry forums, author technical papers, and deliver keynote presentations to position Cadence as a market leader.

Qualifications

• 15+ years of experience in IC design implementation and signoff, with demonstrated success in managing large-scale technical programs.

• BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.

• Deep expertise in digital design fundamentals, advanced node STA & ECOs (3nm and below), and EDA tool ecosystems.

• Core timing signoff expertise, advanced node STA, UPF & constraints debugging, hierarchical & 3DIC design STA and closure solutions

• Proven track record of leading technical teams and driving customer success at executive levels.

• Strong proficiency in scripting (Tcl, Python, Perl) and flow customization for design closure.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and leadership skills with the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders.

• Prior experience with Cadence tools (Tempus, Certus, QRC) and competitive solutions highly desirable.

The annual salary range for Washington is $154,000 to $286,000. You may also be eligible to receive incentive compensation: bonus, equity, and benefits. Our benefits programs include: paid vacation and paid holidays, 401(k) plan with employer match, employee stock purchase plan, a variety of medical, dental and vision plan options, and more.

title: Yopa Estate Agent
description:
We’re looking for talented experienced estate agents with the drive to build their own business as a Territory Manager under the Yopa franchise. Yopa is one of the largest estate agency brands in the UK. Our service rivals the high street, while our unique technology-led offering gives customers a reason to choose us over the competition. We sell homes for a fair fixed fee that saves the average customer £2,800 (£6,000 in London), while also offering a No Sale, No Fee option that isn’t available with our main competitors. Our award-winning hybrid service has been named the best of its kind in the UK, and we’re rated ‘excellent’ by Trustpilot based on thousands of customer reviews.
As a Territory Manager, you will have your own postcodes and the opportunity to grow your business, with full control over your own agenda and supported by the Territory Owner for the area. You’ll be building your own business, but far from being alone, you will be part of a close-knit regional team and benefit from everything Yopa has to offer in terms of business support, including:

• Fantastic free lead generation, with a focus on quality, from the central Yopa team with appointments booked in for you.

• Extra financial incentive for self-generated leads.

• Multiple revenue streams to help you diversify your business and income, including rewards for referring customers to our partnered conveyancers and our sister company Scout Financial Services.

• The option to set your own commission rates with No Sale, No Fee.

• The autonomy to run your own business with flexible hours that fit your existing commitments, and the freedom to employ your own team.

• No earnings cap - the only limit is your potential.

• An in-house marketing team providing personalised support, with free money every month to spend on marketing materials.

• Unique schemes that help you build your business’s visibility in the local area, such as Yopa ’s successful Tech for Schools sponsorship programme.

• The full support of a team in our Contact Centres, including your own Personal Property Adviser to help your business stay in touch with your customers.

• Ongoing training and support from the Learning and Development team, mentorship from your Divisional Franchise Director, and regular meetings with fellow colleagues and business owners.

In return, we’re looking for estate agents who:

• Already have strong experience in the world of estate agency, with a proven track record in valuing and listing homes, and who can confidently see the buying and selling journey through to completion.

• Demonstrate exceptional levels of customer service, with the willingness to help customers outside of ‘office hours’ and go the extra mile for that sale.

• Self-starters with the drive to build a long-term business that goes beyond the end of the month or the next paycheck.

If you’re a passionate estate agent who wants to own your own business, benefit from first-in-class support, and help build the future of estate agency, we want to hear from you!

title: Senior Security GRC Engineer
description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we're doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission - to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders - only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

Sightline Institute is hiring a Principal Director, Program Development, to build our next research program, and then the one after that. This position is new, created to identify and launch new research areas. The Principal Director scouts, vets, and recommends each new program area. Then they launch it: conducting and publishing the original research that establishes Sightline’s credibility in the field, developing the strategy, anchoring early fundraising, and helping recruit the program’s permanent director. Once that director is in place, the Principal Director begins again with the next area, in a recurring three- to five-year cycle. The handoff is by design. The goal is a new program that stands on its own, led by someone hired to carry it forward, so the Principal Director can start the next one. The Principal Director is an accomplished researcher, a skilled writer and speaker, and an experienced program builder. Because the subject changes every few years, we are less interested in deep expertise in any one field than in range. You would be joining an organization of experienced staff members, fully remote across Cascadia. New programs have always come out of our team of researchers and communicators, kicking ideas around until someone finds the angle. We are more a guild of artisans than a factory, and this role is also built to work that way: you would be working in collaboration with colleagues who know the region and its politics well. This full-time, salaried role reports to the Executive Director and works in close partnership with Sightline’s senior staff. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a respected organization with an established track record of success while ushering in expanded areas of impact and reach. Several of these were US firsts. Our work on election reform has helped shape how Alaska, Portland, and Seattle run their elections.
In our programs on climate and energy, housing and cities, and democracy and elections, we identify and promote reforms that yield outsized improvements for the region’s people and places. A nonprofit, nonpartisan, and independent public policy research center, Sightline provides research, articles, and commentary; maps, graphics, and tools; and framing and messaging guidance. Sightline’s influence depends on the depth and breadth of our researchers’ expertise and their persuasiveness in presenting analysis and arguments. We aim to draw attention to and build support for data-backed solutions to specific public problems through close engagement in policy debates. Community & Operations

title: Real Estate AI Research Contributor
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Aptura is looking for Subject Matter Experts from real estate investment, development or lending, across any property type, who build acquisition, development and waterfall models in Excel. You have used AI tools on your own work and been frustrated by the mistakes they make. You will turn that experience into realistic Excel tasks that test how well AI does the modelling work of a Real Estate Analyst.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Writing realistic Excel tasks drawn from your own work: extending existing models, fixing broken ones and building from a brief

- Working through each task yourself so there is a clear, correct answer

- Writing yes-or-no criteria precise enough that a grader can mark any attempt against them

NECESSARY QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years in real estate private equity, development, REITs or real estate lending, covering at least one asset class (office, residential/multifamily, industrial/logistics, retail, hospitality or data centres)

- Deep hands-on Excel: acquisition and development models, promote waterfalls, circular references, goal seek and financial functions

- Strong written English communication skills.

- Attention to detail, and willingness to learn concepts in AI and Evals

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

- Start Date : Immediate

- Duration: Approximately 4-6 weeks

- Payment: task-based. Experts who complete their first task within the required timeline will then be qualified to do multiple tasks for the remainder of the project.

CONTRACT AND PAYMENT TERMS

- You will be engaged as an independent contractor.

- This is a fully remote role that can be completed on your own schedule.

- Projects can be extended, shortened, or concluded early depending on needs and performance.

- Your work at Aptura will not involve access to confidential or proprietary information from any employer, client, or institution.

- Payments will be weekly following task completion.

GETTING STARTED

- Apply with your details and CV. Choose an available 30-minute group walkthrough call.

- Attend the walkthrough and create one original task from your own work. Submit the brief, the actual input workbook(s) needed to complete it. Input-file uploads are compulsory.

- Write the brief yourself. Input workbooks must also be human-built. Use real data that has been sanitised, or public data with the source named. No AI usage allowed.

- We run your task against current frontier AI models. If the models get it wrong, you then write a detailed yes-or-no rubric, and a reviewer signs off on the task with you.

- Completing onboarding does not guarantee a job offer; selection remains subject to written approval of the task proposal.

ABOUT APTURA

Aptura is an applied AI and data company working with frontier labs to train AI systems on real professional work. We do this by building high-quality evaluation and training environments that teach AI agents to produce work that can be used in daily workflows.

title: Staff Application Security Engineer
description:
ROLE SUMMARY

Join our dynamic team as a Staff Application Security Engineer, where you'll play a pivotal role in securing the Temporal development pipeline, product, and customer execution environment. In this position, you'll work closely with software engineering teams and customers to build security deeply into our platform across multiple clouds. You'll also build production ready AI assisted security workflows with the right guardrails. We're looking for individuals who are passionate about enabling engineering teams to build and ship securely, serving as trusted security partners across the organization.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Collaborate with product and engineering teams to integrate security principles into the design and architecture of products.

- Lead complex threat modeling and risk assessments to identify vulnerabilities and potential attack vectors across the full product surface.

- Drive strategy, influence architecture, and set direction for security across multiple teams or org-wide.

- Manage the Secure Development pipeline including code security and 3rd party library supply chain security.

- Stay current on emerging standards and guidance (e.g. OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, MCP security specifications) and translate these into actionable internal policy.

- Own responsibility disclosed vulnerabilities in both Cloud and Open Source products.

- Able to participate in on-call rotation.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

- 7+ years in application or product security or a related role.

- Proven partnership with engineering teams, bringing security expertise to the planning and development process.

- Ability to write production-quality code in at least one programming language, with a history of development beyond simple scripting.

- Knowledge of encryption, authentication, and secure communication protocols.

- Familiarity with tools like SAST, DAST, and penetration testing frameworks.

- A deep understanding of application architecture and design principles, ability to effectively identify vulnerabilities across multiple programming languages

- Excellent communication and ability to explain complex security concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

- Kubernetes security posture management and auditing, including workload hardening, RBAC design, and admission control.

- Demonstrated experience with multi-tenant security architecture, including data plane isolation, control plane hardening, and cross-tenant data leakage prevention.

NICE TO HAVE

- Distributed computing and related vulnerability experience.

- Familiarity with Go.

- Running a Security Champions program.

- Open Source automation or automation projects.

- Expertise in other areas of security.

- Security conference talks or published research.

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Position Summary
Anduril's real estate portfolio covers 10M sq ft of R&D labs, manufacturing hubs, and offices worldwide. As Portfolio Planning & Strategy Lead , you will own the planning process that decides how much space Anduril needs, of what type, where, and when.

You'll report to the Director of Strategic Real Estate. You'll turn headcount plans, program schedules, and portfolio data into forecasts of demand and supply. You'll measure how well we use what we already have, and make the case for what to do next to division leaders and the C-suite.

This is a hands-on senior role. It suits someone who builds their own models and can work from incomplete, inconsistent data. You should already use LLMs and modern data platforms (Palantir Foundry or similar) in your work. The ideal candidate combines real estate and financial judgment with a builder's instinct and a creative, tech-forward approach to problems that have no playbook.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the Real Estate Planning Cycle. Run the quarterly portfolio forecast end to end:

• Gather headcount and program plans from Finance, Corporate Operations, and the business divisions;

• Reconcile competing plans into one view of demand by division, workforce type, and region;

• Publish the 5-10 year outlook that portfolio decisions rest on;

• Track plan vs. actual across forecast versions, and explain why the numbers moved.

• Portfolio Demand & Supply Forecasting. Forecast seat, office, R&D, and production space demand against current and committed supply. Quantify the gaps by market and year. Model scenarios (growth cases, program wins and losses, M&A, relocations, divestitures) and their OpEx and CapEx impact.

• Efficiency & Utilization Measurement. Define and track the metrics that show whether the portfolio is working: SF per head, seat ratios, utilization, cost per seat, and production space relative to output. Benchmark them against peers. Turn the findings into recommendations to consolidate, densify, restructure leases, or expand.

• Workforce Strategy. Work with Talent, People, and division leaders to understand how Anduril grows: hiring velocity, workforce mix (engineering, production, G&A), in-office patterns, and talent markets. Translate that into location strategy, market selection, and site timing.

• Executive Communications. Build and present the decision materials that get C-suite and division-leader decisions made: quarterly business reviews, expansion option analyses, and leadership briefings. Lead with the answer, show the math, and stand behind the numbers.

• Build the Planning System, Not Just the Plan. Maintain and extend our planning data pipeline and models (Palantir Foundry, Python/SQL, version-controlled datasets with automated validation), so forecasts are repeatable, auditable, and refreshable in hours. Use LLM-based agents to automate data extraction, reconciliation, analysis, and presentation production, and set the standard for how the team uses them.

Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. At NVIDIA , as a Principal Rack Scale Systems Infrastructure Engineer, you will build and guide the development of software systems. These systems support our upcoming rack-scale infrastructure products and services. This exceptional role sits where software meets hardware. You will work on control planes, state machines, orchestration systems, firmware, OS lifecycle, and networking fabrics. Your task is to compose infrastructure-as-a-service control plane software that converts complex rack-scale hardware into dependable, manageable, and programmable infrastructure for NVIDIA , partners, and leading cloud and enterprise clients globally.

Establish reliability, security, validation, and left-shift strategies that reduce risk before hardware reaches production environments.

• Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, raising the engineering bar for large-scale networked systems, foundational software, and rack-scale control plane development.

• Make high-quality technical decisions in ambiguous environments, balancing customer needs, schedule, hardware realities, software maintainability, open source adoption, and long-term infrastructure evolution.

What We Need To See:

• BS or MS in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Proven experience (15+ years) in systems architecture, system software, distributed systems, infrastructure control planes, or infrastructure engineering.

• Solid architectural knowledge of coordination frameworks, state machines, declarative APIs, reconciliation loops, lifecycle orchestration, failure handling, upgrade and rollback workflows, and distributed systems tradeoffs.

• Practical coding skills in Go, C++, or Rust, encompassing the capability to write, review, and direct production-quality infrastructure software. Experience with Rust is highly valued.

• Experience with Kubernetes or similar orchestration systems, especially as a fab

title: Fraud Prevention Engineer
description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we’ve become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Ensuring Authenticity for Billions of Daily Rewards

Industry reports suggest 25 percent of global mobile ad spend is lost to fraudulent activities like click farms, fake installs, SDK spoofing, and emulator farms. At adjoe, we define our platform through trust and proactive engineering. We build high-performance defenses that guarantee accurate reward attribution, ensuring every interaction is authentic. This creates a sustainable value exchange that empowers our partners to grow with confidence.

The Anti-Fraud team develops systems that detect and prevent malicious activity at scale. Our custom Android and iOS SDKs analyze device integrity for modifications like Xposed frameworks, Magisk modules, and jailbroken devices. Supporting these, Go microservices and DynamoDB deliver millisecond-level responses, while Kafka and SQS process billions of daily events in real time. This infrastructure protects publisher margins and ensures a trustworthy platform for all users.

YOUR MISSION & WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

- AdTech Domain & Anti-Fraud Core Requirement
You bring a solid foundation in the AdTech ecosystem (publishers, advertisers, SDK attribution, monetization) and direct exposure to cheating in mobile games. Joining our Anti-Fraud Operations unit, you will act as the primary technical PoC for Support, Sales, and BI teams, owning complex fraud escalations and translating business edge cases into technical fixes.

- Investigative Mindset & Root-Cause Analysis
You possess eagle-eyed curiosity and an investigative, hacker mindset. When publisher margins drop, external platforms (iOS/Android) shift, or campaigns misbehave, you won't wait for step-by-step instructions-you will connect messy clues, reproduce exploit scenarios, and trace non-obvious fraud patterns to their source.

- AI-Empowered Big Data Interrogation

Send your CV and portfolio to .

Programs launch against a calendar set by card releases and sports moments, so the team builds reusable platform capability rather than one-off campaign code.

Working closely with Product, Design, Backend and Platform Engineering, this role will translate program requirements into shared components, state handling and telemetry that serve many programs rather than one.

As a player-coach, this leader will set technical direction, establish priorities, coach and develop engineers, remove delivery blockers and raise engineering standards. The role is expected to spend significant time designing, coding, reviewing and operating production software while ensuring the broader cohort delivers against Collector Engagement priorities.

Because the work directly impacts tax compliance, financial accuracy, and client outcomes , precision and reliability are critical. Mistakes here don’t just create internal issues - they can affect filings, liabilities, and client trust.
Your Role
We’re hiring a CPA / EA Tax Accountant to support US business tax returns (e.g., Forms 1120, 1120S, and 1065 ) for a Part-Time position to start (5-10hr/week), with the possibility of transitioning to full-time down the road.
This is an execution-focused role . You’ll work closely with senior tax professionals and be responsible for preparing returns, organizing client documentation, and supporting filings with a high level of accuracy.
This is not a strategy-heavy or advisory role - the focus is on doing the work well, consistently, and on time .
Strong communication is essential. You’ll be working in a remote team supporting US-based clients, so clarity and responsiveness matter.
You’ll:

• Prepare US business tax returns (e.g., 1120 / 1120S / 1065 ) under supervision

• Work from client financials (trial balance, general ledger) and supporting workpapers (depreciation schedules, K-1s, book-to-tax adjustments, etc.)

• Support tax filings and compliance processes (including extensions and state filings as applicable)

• Organize and review client financial documentation

• Assist senior accountants with tax preparation and deliverables

• Ensure documentation is complete, accurate, and audit-ready

• Track deadlines and support timely submissions during tax cycles

• Communicate clearly with internal teams on progress, blockers, and updates

You Bring:

• 2-5+ years of experience in accounting or tax roles

• 3-5 years with a completed CPA or EA certificate

• Hands-on experience with US business tax returns ( 1120 / 1120S / 1065 or similar)

• Strong understanding of business tax basics (entity structures, income/expenses, depreciation, deductions, credits)

• Good written and spoken English ( critical for this role )

• High attention to detail and accuracy

• Ability to follow structured processes and meet deadlines

• Comfort working in a remote, distributed team

Bonus Points:

• Experience working with US-based clients or firms

• Experience in tax season environments (high volume of returns)

• Familiarity with tools like QuickBooks, tax software, or Excel

• Experience with multi-entity clients (multiple returns, consolidations, or partnership allocations)

• Exposure to industries like real estate, SaaS, or investment funds

What’s Offered:

• Fully remote contractor role

• Work aligned with U.S. business hours (overlap required)

• Competitive USD compensation (based on experience)

• 20 days PTO + U.S. holidays

• High exposure to US tax work and real-world client scenarios

• Opportunity to grow within a fast-moving finance team

1️⃣ Application review
2️⃣ Recruiter screen - experience and alignment

5️⃣ Short challenge to assess skills

🔴 Important Note

This role requires strong English communication and real experience with US business tax returns (e.g., 1120 / 1120S / 1065 ).
Candidates without hands-on experience preparing business returns or with limited communication ability will not be considered.

Warum wir das tun: Die Energieversorgung der Zukunft wird anders aussehen als die, die wir heute kennen. Wir müssen über unsere Zukunft nicht nur nachdenken, sondern sie aktiv gestalten. Jetzt.

Seit über vier Jahren lizenzieren wir Kraken und unterstützen Unternehmen bei ihrer Transformation. Dabei übertragen wir nicht nur ihren Kundenstamm auf unsere Kraken-Plattform, sondern verändern auch ihre Betriebsmodelle und Arbeitsweisen. In dieser Zeit hat unser Team wegweisende Migrationen in der Branche vorangetrieben und neue Maßstäbe dafür gesetzt, wie Unternehmenstransformation aussehen kann.

🏠 Deine Rolle bei uns:

Du wirst Teil des Client-Delivery-Teams bei Kraken und begleitest europäische Kunden auf ihrem Weg durch die technologische Transformation. Dabei unterstützt du langfristige Migrationsprojekte.

Als Client Delivery Lead verantwortest du einen technologischen Fachbereich, beispielsweise Abrechnung, Finanzen oder Kommunikation, innerhalb unserer Kundenprojekte. Dabei geht es entweder um die Migration auf unsere Kraken-Plattform oder um die Betreuung langfristiger technologischer Anforderungen. Du arbeitest eng mit den technischen und operativen Teams von Kraken sowie mit dem Kunden zusammen, um die jeweiligen Projekt- und Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

Als Client Delivery Lead musst du genau verstehen, wie Kraken funktioniert. Du analysierst die vom Kunden gemeldeten Probleme und Anforderungen und konkretisierst passende Lösungen, um bestehende und neue Funktionen optimal zu nutzen. Du bringst Technologie, Menschen und Prozesse zusammen, um innovative Verbesserungen für unsere Kunden zu ermöglichen. Außerdem unterstützt du den Kunden dabei, Arbeitsweisen einzuführen, die zum Entwicklungsansatz von Kraken passen. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Produktmanagern und Entwicklern zusammen, bringst Entwicklungsanforderungen ein und bildest die Schnittstelle zum Kunden.

🚀 Dafür übernimmst du Verantwortung:

- Du betreust die Beziehungen zu deinen Ansprechpartnern auf Kundenseite, häufig Product Owner und fachlich Verantwortliche.

- Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für technische Weiterentwicklungen sowie für die Eskalation und Lösung von Problemen in deinem jeweiligen Fach- oder Produktbereich.

- Du bist die zentrale Wissensquelle dafür, wie Kraken funktioniert und wie wir die Kraken-Plattform bereitstellen.

- Du sichtest und priorisierst eingehende Anfragen und kommunizierst die Prioritäten der Kunden intern.

- Du fasst Kundenanforderungen, relevante Rahmenbedingungen und Zeitpläne zusammen und vermittelst sie intern, um die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Kraken-Plattform zu ermöglichen.

- Du unterstützt das Entwicklungsteam bei der Umsetzung von Produktfunktionen.

- Du regst Kunden dazu an, technische Entwicklung neu zu denken, und vertrittst unseren Ansatz der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung und Bereitstellung mit Überzeugung.

title: Senior Manager, Global Meetings & Events
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

SENIOR MANAGER, GLOBAL MEETINGS & EVENTS

POSITION SUMMARY

The Senior Manager, Global Meetings & Events (M&E) will play a critical role in building and advancing the company’s global M&E program. Reporting to the Senior Director, Global Travel & Expense and Events, this role will lead the development of scalable sourcing strategies, supplier models, governance, and technology-enabled processes that improve how meetings and events are sourced and managed globally.

The Senior Manager will lead strategic sourcing and commercial initiatives across the M&E portfolio, including event agencies, hotels and venues, production partners, destination management companies (DMCs), event technology, and other strategic suppliers. The role will leverage enterprise spend and demand to improve commercial outcomes, strengthen supplier performance, and create greater visibility and consistency across the M&E ecosystem.

Beyond individual sourcing initiatives, this role will help build the infrastructure of a modern M&E program - including preferred supplier strategies, sourcing and contracting standards, service tiers, spend analytics, performance measurement, and self-service capabilities.

Working closely with M&E Operations, Travel, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Marketing, Sales, and business stakeholders, this role will help transform M&E sourcing into a scalable, data-driven global program.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

M&E PROGRAM STRATEGY & TRANSFORMATION

- Develop and execute the global M&E program roadmap.

- Establish scalable processes, governance, service tiers, sourcing thresholds, and decision frameworks across the M&E lifecycle.

- Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize how meetings and events are sourced across regions and business functions.

- Lead cross-functional initiatives that advance the future-state M&E operating model, including playbooks, tools, and self-service capabilities.

- Drive adoption of new processes and ways of working through stakeholder engagement and change management.

- Partner with M&E leadership, Operations, and cross-functional stakeholders to establish clear roles, responsibilities, and handoffs across strategic sourcing, program governance, and event planning and execution.

STRATEGIC SOURCING & SUPPLIER MANAGEMENT

- Lead strategic sourcing for complex and high-value M&E spend, including agencies, hotels and venues, production, DMCs, event technology, and other event-related categories.

- Develop sourcing and preferred supplier strategies that leverage aggregate enterprise demand and increase purchasing power.

- Lead complex RFPs, supplier evaluations, commercial negotiations, and contracting in partnership with Procurement, Legal, and business stakeholders.

- Establish commercial frameworks, preferred terms, and supplier models that optimize cost, service, flexibility, and risk.

- Develop supplier governance and performance management, including KPIs, SLAs, scorecards, business reviews, and escalation mechanisms.

- Identify and deliver measurable savings, cost avoidance, negotiated value, and process efficiencies.

- Establish commercial standards and controls for event-related spend, including pricing transparency, contract terms, payment structures, and cancellation protections.

description:
About the Company:

Industrious is the largest premium workplace-as-a-service provider and home to the highest-rated workplaces in the industry. Everything we do comes down to creating great days for teams of all sizes and stages, including our own. We believe that what makes a great day at work is the people on your team and the problems you get to solve together. We’re looking for people who love thinking outside the box and thrive in a truly collaborative setting. As teammates, we encourage new ideas and toast every win. We’re excited about having a meaningful impact on people’s workplace experience.

Great days also start when everyone can be their authentic self at work. Diversity of backgrounds, thoughts, and ideas is critical to our success in delivering great workplace experiences, both for our members and for each other. Industrious is committed to creating an inclusive, respectful environment that embraces your individuality and quirkiness. You are valued for who YOU are. We celebrate our people as individuals who can accomplish great things when we work together as one team.

To learn more, visit www.industriousoffice.com/careers http://www.industriousoffice.com/careers.

About the Role

Industrious signs new landlord partnerships every year, and the number is growing as our business development team expands. Before any of those deals move forward, someone has to check that it holds together: that the assumptions are sound, that the start date, budgets, rent, pricing, and returns all track, and that the figures from design and construction have carried through correctly. As a Real Estate Associate on our Real Estate Transactions team that will be your job!

You will underwrite assigned deals in Excel, explain what drives their returns, and flag where a deal is tight, whether on pricing, occupancy, or CapEx. Our business development colleagues make the call on whether a deal goes ahead, and your analysis is what they rely on to make it well. You will work with Design, Construction, Finance, and other teams to make sure every number is right, supporting several business development colleagues as deal flow shifts.

Our approach to underwriting is different from a traditional real estate shop, and we will teach it to you. In your first few months you will get close review and clear guidance while you learn how we work. You will also join at a good time: the team is growing, new roles are being added, and we are underwriting a new product, so there is real room to learn, ask questions, and grow with us.

Success here means accurate work. The team trusts your numbers, your flags are clear, and any mistake you make happens once, not twice.

What Might Your Day Look Like

Your morning starts with a new deal from one of our business development colleagues. You go through the model piece by piece: the start date, the budget, the rent and revenue share assumptions, the cash flows, the IRR, and the margin the location is expected to earn per rentable square foot. The returns look fine at first, but pricing is tighter than it seems, so you note it clearly with the number that would need to change.

Late morning, updated figures arrive from Design and Construction. You check that they have flowed into the model correctly. One CapEx figure does not match the construction budget, so you confirm the right number with the construction team before it goes any further.

In the afternoon, you walk your business development colleague through the deal: what the returns look like, where the risk sits, and which assumptions matter most. They decide what happens next. Then priorities shift, and another colleague needs support on a deal heading to Investment Committee, so you move over and check that every figure in the review material ties back to the underwriting.

Before you wrap up, you update your trackers and checklists so the team knows where every deal you are supporting stands.

What You Will Own

- Underwrite assigned deals in Excel

About the role

The APD Adjuster investigates and settles physical damage claims arising from rental vehicle accidents, including damage to the rental unit, third-party vehicles, and property. You determine coverage, liability and value, then close each file quickly, fairly and with clear documentation.

Who you are

Qualifications

• 3-5 years of auto physical damage or commercial auto claims experience.

• Working knowledge of vehicle repair, estimating and total loss valuation.

• Strong negotiation, written communication and time-management skills.

• High school diploma required; bachelor’s degree or AIC/CPCU progress preferred.

• Active adjuster license: resident-state license where available, otherwise a Designated Home State (DHS) license. Willing to obtain any additional required licenses within 60 days, including state testing.

Benefits

• Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental

• 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching

• Competitive PTO policy - we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!

• Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work

title: Senior Data Scientist, Experimentation
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay makes millions of dynamic, interconnected decisions across its network every day, and each one shapes the experience of the thousands of couriers who work with us. Knowing what any one of those decisions actually did is hard: couriers interfere with each other, effects vary from person to person, and the outcomes that matter compound over time.

Science at Relay is the brain of the operation: machine learning, operational research, recommender systems, causal inference, location intelligence and experimentation, working together to decide how every parcel gets delivered. You'll lead causal inference at Relay from the start.

CAUSAL INFERENCE HIGHLIGHTS

- A live, two-sided marketplace to experiment in, with every decision logged across millions of parcels.

- Interference between couriers, heterogeneous effects and long-term outcomes are the norm here, not the exception.

- Four marketplaces, each with its own app and its own economics.

- Your insights and models feed straight into Relay's network-wide optimisation.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Senior Data Scientist at Relay, you'll:

- Set the standard for causal inference at Relay.

- Measure how our decisions affect each courier, today and over time.

- Shape how Relay experiments across a live, two-sided marketplace.

- Adapt advanced techniques across causal inference, statistics and machine learning to Relay's problems, and see them through to production.

- Partner with Operational Research to embed your insights and models into Relay's network-wide optimisation, and help build our research culture and voice in the tech community.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO…

- Bring deep expertise in causal inference, experimentation and machine learning, whether from a PhD, publications, or years at the frontier in industry.

- Come from statistics, an experimental science such as biology or psychology, or quantitative research.

- Have applied advanced techniques to real marketplaces or products, and owned the outcome.

- Think in mechanisms, and let evidence guide decisions.

- Are energised by open, interconnected problems, and know how to find the signal.

- Collaborate generously, and explain complex ideas simply.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

- Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

- Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

- 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

- All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

- People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust

title: Senior Security Engineer, Detection & Response
description:
For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well.

For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you.

Angi at a glance:

- Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021

- Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide

- Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

About the team:

At Angi, security is woven into everything we build, from PCI-scoped payment flows to the AI agents now handling homeowner/pro conversations and scheduling end-to-end. Detection signal spans cloud, endpoint, identity, SaaS, and a growing set of autonomous agents. You'll own detection and response as an engineering problem: build the detections, build the automation that works them, and carry the pager for what still gets through.

While this is a remote position, we are a global company and are looking for applicants located in eastern or central time zones to align with our team's working hours.

What you’ll do:

- Build and own detections across AWS (GuardDuty, CloudTrail, SecurityHub), EDR, identity, SaaS, and our AI gateway. Coverage, precision, and latency are properties we manage across a rule's lifecycle.

- Own the security log pipeline, and own it as a product with consumers: audit and security logs land centrally and are exposed to the teams that need them for triage, analysis, and incident response.

- Own detection on the application protection layer - account takeover, credential stuffing, and abuse patterns against a two-sided marketplace.

- Build the triage layer - enrichment, correlation, containment, evidence capture - working toward a median alert that resolves without a human touching it. Use LLM and agentic tooling where it earns its place, and own the verification layer that makes that output trustworthy.

- Buy the tool where a tool is right, build where it isn't, and extend where it's close. You'll ship code in a repo, not only configure consoles.

- Extend detection coverage to Angi's agentic AI products: what anomalous behavior looks like for an autonomous agent holding calendar and account access - prompt injection attempts, tool-call abuse, data exfiltration through the agent surface.

- Actively participate in all facets of the incident response lifecycle by participating in a 24/7 on-call rotation.

- Own the technical controls InfoSec retains for detection within compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS (tamper-detection monitoring, log integrity, alerting coverage).

- Partner with platform and product teams so new services ship with telemetry, threat models, and response playbooks. You will be in the room when these are designed, not brought in after the fact.

Who you are:

- You have 5+ years of experience working on a security team supporting product/engineering functions, cloud infrastructure, and corporate infrastructure development

- You have software engineering experience (Python preferred) and an engineering mindset for building reliable / maintainable security infrastructure to support a large organization with CI/CD software engineering practices

- You are at home in the analytics and observability stack detections get measured on - Grafana, Looker, NewRelic or similar. You will build your own coverage and precision dashboards rather than filing a ticket for them.

- Hands-on with AWS and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent); working knowledge of EDR, SIEM, and SOAR platforms and their APIs.

- Hands-on with containers and Kubernetes, including what detection and forensics look like on that surface.

- Sound build-versus-buy judgment with no allergy to either answer. You reach for what exists when it fits,

title: AI Trainer (SWE) - Remote
description:
Job Description: Machine Learning Engineer - AI Training & Model Evaluation
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Global (Fully Remote)
Time Commitment: 15+ Hours per Week
Schedule: Flexible
About the Role
We are seeking experienced Machine Learning Engineers with prior professional AI training or model evaluation experience to contribute to a project focused on improving advanced AI systems.
In this role, you will apply your machine learning expertise to develop challenging technical tasks, evaluate AI-generated outputs, identify model failures, and establish objective standards for technical accuracy. This opportunity is intended for professionals who have already completed substantial AI training, benchmarking, or model evaluation work.
Key Responsibilities

• Create realistic machine learning engineering tasks that challenge advanced AI models.

• Develop detailed task instructions, reproducible environments, reference solutions, and evaluation criteria.

• Evaluate AI-generated code, experiments, analyses, and technical deliverables.

• Identify technical issues involving data leakage, incorrect validation, unstable training, performance limitations, and reproducibility.

• Assess model-generated solutions for correctness, reliability, and technical quality.

• Provide actionable feedback to improve AI model performance and evaluation standards.

Required Skills and Qualifications

• Prior paid professional experience in training, evaluating, benchmarking, or improving AI systems.

• Strong practical proficiency in Python.

• Hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks and tools such as PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, or equivalent technologies.

• Strong understanding of machine learning workflows, model validation, training methodologies, and performance evaluation.

Public Proof of Technical Expertise
Strong applicants should provide publicly verifiable evidence of their technical expertise, such as:

• GitHub repositories or public machine learning implementations.

• Kaggle, DrivenData, AIcrowd, or similar competition results.

• Hugging Face models or datasets.

• Research publications or technical reports.

• Open-source machine learning contributions.

• Public benchmarks, experiments, or technical projects.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience creating AI training tasks, reference answers, evaluation rubrics, graders, or benchmark problems.

• Experience reviewing technical submissions from other AI trainers.

• Kaggle Expert, Master, or Grandmaster status, or strong results in other technical competitions.

• Publications or open-source contributions in machine learning.

• Experience with long-horizon or agentic AI evaluations.

• Availability to begin immediately.

Application Process

• Submit your application, including details of your AI training experience and publicly verifiable technical contributions.

• Complete an AI interview involving technical and integrity checks.

• Undergo a Hiring Manager review.

• If selected, complete project onboarding and begin your first assigned task.
